li.label: worked their herds
li.description: A day and a half with another people's herds. Their animals didn't know me, but by the end they went where I sent them.

li.label: carved for them
li.description: I did the carving in another people's building. They will walk past my work every day for years.

li.label: cooked their feast
li.description: A whole day in someone else's kitchen, cooking for their feast. They ate every bit of it.

li.label: an honest measure
li.description: A trader showed me how to tell an honest scale from a crooked one. Nobody will cheat me on weight again.

li.label: a visitor's grace
li.description: I sat at the table with a visitor, and they said their people's words of thanks first. It was a good way to start.

li.label: a wild one up close
li.description: I went closer to a wild animal than I should have. I'd never seen one that near.

li.label: a forester's advice
li.description: A visitor told me which trees their people leave standing and why. I'll look at the woods differently now.

li.label: a new stitch
li.description: A visitor showed me a weave their people use. I want to try it on the next thing I make.

li.label: out of the glare
li.description: A visitor showed me how their people keep the glare of the snow out of their eyes. My eyes don't ache any more.

li.label: sound rock
li.description: A visitor told me how their people tell sound rock from rock that will fall. I'll listen to the rock before I dig into it.

li.label: agreed on the line
li.description: A visitor and I talked over where our land ends and theirs begins. We agreed without any trouble.
